description: Render a spec to SVG, PNG, draw.io, editable draw.io SVG, a React TSX component or a standalone HTML page. Nothing renders while the spec has errors (see the diagnostics). With out_dir (stdio only) the files are written there and their paths returned; otherwise the result carries a JSON receipt, then each output in order: PNGs as images, the others as text.

animate.description: SVG motion: packets, flow, relay or none. Default: the skin's (packets for classic, relay for stage). PNG is always still.

name.description: File name stem for outputs: lowercase letters, digits and -. Default: the spec file's name, else diagram.

out_dir.description: Absolute folder to write the files to (stdio only). Existing files are replaced.

scale.description: PNG pixels per diagram unit. Default 3 with out_dir, 2 inline.

skin.description: classic (vendor deck look) or stage (dark product look). Default: the spec's skin.

spec.description: The diagram spec as YAML (or JSON) text. Pass this or spec_path, not both.

spec_path.description: Absolute path of a spec file on this machine (stdio only). Its folder resolves relative icons: paths.

theme.description: both renders a light and a dark file. Default: the spec's theme.

name: render
title: Render a diagram
